narration.text: One teaspoon of neutron-star matter could weigh around a billion tons.
It comes from a neutron star - the dead core of a giant star.
A star that burned up to twenty times the mass of our Sun.
When the fuel ran out, gravity crushed the core in under a second.
The star exploded as a supernova - but the core kept collapsing.
Until two Suns' worth of mass packed into a sphere the size of a city.
So dense, protons and electrons are crushed into a sea of neutrons.
Scoop a teaspoon of that? Around a billion tons.

shots.visual_need: Show a teaspoon physically, up close
shots.visual_claim: a real teaspoon exists in the viewer's world
shots.why_shot_exists: The entire premise: without a physical teaspoon the hook number has no anchor. Removing it loses the hook.

shots.visual_need: The impossible weight, instantly: a billion tons slammed onto the teaspoon
shots.source_type: built stat graphic over the same photo
shots.factual_risk: medium - number is density-dependent; text uses 'around' (approx sign)
shots.on_screen_label: the stat overlay itself (graphic text with '≈' notation)
shots.why_shot_exists: The number is the pattern interrupt; slamming it on the cut inside the sentence makes hook and visual land together. Removing it defers the reveal to the payoff.

shots.visual_need: What a neutron star IS: a small, bright, dense sphere
shots.visual_claim: a neutron star is a compact stellar corpse
shots.factual_risk: low - labeled impression, not a photograph
shots.on_screen_label: ARTIST'S IMPRESSION (NASA) - baked into the staged asset
shots.why_shot_exists: Establishes the object before any physics; gives the audience the mental image the rest of the story references. Removing it leaves beats 3-7 abstract.

shots.visual_need: The star that died was ENORMOUS - scale contrast against the tiny sphere
shots.visual_claim: the parent star lived inside a vast star-forming region
shots.factual_risk: low - real telescopic observation of a massive-star nursery (Carina Nebula)
shots.why_shot_exists: Scale contrast: huge nebula right after the tiny pulsar makes the collapse story shocking. Removing it flattens the emotional arc.

shots.visual_need: Collapse: the star shrinking into itself in under a second
shots.visual_claim: the core collapses to a 20 km sphere in under a second
shots.why_shot_exists: The mechanism cannot be filmed; an explicit labeled simulation is the truthful way to teach it. Removing it skips the cause, leaving only the supernova effect.

shots.visual_need: The explosion is a REAL, observed event
shots.visual_claim: a real supernova remnant (Crab Nebula) is still expanding, observed by telescopes
shots.why_shot_exists: Real evidence the explosion happened; the only moving REAL footage in the piece. Removing it turns the story into pure graphics.

shots.visual_need: A real city, so 'size of a city' is concrete
shots.visual_claim: a 20 km sphere is comparable to a city
shots.why_shot_exists: Ground-truths the comparison in the real world before the schematic. Removing it makes the city-size step abstract.

shots.visual_need: SUN -> CITY: two Suns' worth of mass shrinking to city scale
shots.visual_claim: two solar masses fit inside a 20 km sphere
shots.factual_risk: medium - schematic; 'not to scale' label on screen
shots.on_screen_label: ILLUSTRATION - NOT TO SCALE - baked into the asset
shots.why_shot_exists: The step SUN->CITY is the core shock of the story; only an explicit comparison can teach it. Removing it loses the central reveal.

shots.visual_need: WHY it is dense: atoms crushed into a sea of neutrons
shots.visual_claim: electrons and protons are crushed together into neutrons
shots.why_shot_exists: The 'why it's dense' step; abstraction requires an explicit diagram. Removing it leaves density unexplained.

shots.visual_need: The payoff: the teaspoon again, reframed
shots.visual_claim: the hook number returns on the same physical object
shots.factual_risk: low - reframed reuse of vs1 (allowed: different crop + narrative return)
shots.why_shot_exists: Closes the loop on the hook; emotional payoff. Removing it ends the video without landing the number.

sfx_policy: Sparse and purposeful: 3 SFX total (impact on weight slam, impact on collapse, impact on payoff). No whoosh-on-every-cut.
caption_policy: Varied styles: word-karaoke bottom captions with emphasis flags; two full-screen number moments (shot-1b, shot-8) via center stat overlay; terms highlighted in karaoke.
